entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0912. Just tell me yes or no, can I return the VeloBand or not?

Okay, one moment while I pull that up, VF886-0912. I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered about 30 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's neither. We had a family emergency. My son was in the hospital, it required an unexpected surgery, and I've just been completely overwhelmed. This is the first chance I've had to even think about it. Is it too late?
I'm very sorry to hear that, I certainly hope your son is recovering well. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now.

Okay, I've reviewed your order and our policy. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor is eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 30, you are well within the window for a full refund. No problem at all.
Great. That's all I needed. What's the next step?

I have just initiated the return process for you. I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Simply attach that to the original box and you can drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
